description: Get the user's saved travel context: loyalty programs and elite tiers, home airport, preferred airlines and cabin, preferred hotel chains, typical trip patterns (business vs leisure, budgets, frequent destinations), plus any preferences they've stated or that have been learned from past conversations. Read it before recommending hotels, flights, or cars; it is the best source of who this traveler is, and nothing else returns stated or learned preferences. For raw evidence from actual past reservations, routes, hotels, airlines, or flight seats, use get_past_trips.
name: get_traveler_context
